name: ogbn-arxiv: Citation Network Benchmark
description: ogbn-arxiv is a directed graph representing the citation network between computer science arXiv papers indexed by Microsoft Academic Graph. Containing 169,343 nodes (papers) and 1,166,243 edges (citations), each node possesses a 128-dimensional feature vector. The task is to predict the primary subject area among 40 CS arXiv subject categories with chronological splits.
